import adsk.core, adsk.fusion, json
def run(_context):
    app=adsk.core.Application.get(); found=False
    for i in range(app.documents.count):
        doc=app.documents.item(i); des=adsk.fusion.Design.cast(doc.products.itemByProductType('DesignProductType'))
        if not des: continue
        for b in des.rootComponent.bRepBodies:
            if b.name=='LEFT_CASE_BOTTOM':
                doc.activate(); found=True
                for sk in des.rootComponent.sketches: sk.isVisible=False
                break
        if found: break
    app.activeViewport.fit()
    ok=app.activeViewport.saveAsImageFile('/tmp/fusion_left_case_clean.png',1600,1000)
    print(json.dumps({'found':found,'saved':bool(ok)}))
